package.description: Optional Revised Section 508 Standards package for ART.
package.author: U.S. Access Board
package.license: Public Domain / official government source summaries
package.legalScope: Implementation aid only; this package does not determine legal applicability or compliance.
package.contentPolicy: Original summaries and links are provided instead of reproducing official standard text.
package.notes: Human Section 508 and Trusted Tester review remains required before production claims.

testingLifecycle.label: Plan
testingLifecycle.summary: Define scope, users, environments, applicable provisions, and evidence.

testingLifecycle.label: Test
testingLifecycle.summary: Use appropriate automated, manual, assistive-technology, and code-inspection techniques.

testingLifecycle.label: Remediate
testingLifecycle.summary: Record failures, prioritize risk, assign owners, and verify fixes.

testingLifecycle.label: Monitor
testingLifecycle.summary: Retest changes and maintain evidence across the ICT lifecycle.

trustedTester.methodology: Trusted Tester is a repeatable manual web accessibility test process using code inspection and browser/assistive-technology checks.

criteria.title: Without Vision
criteria.desc: Where a visual mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that does not require user vision.
criteria.requirement: Where a visual mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that does not require user vision.
criteria.testingRequirements: Evaluate each applicable visual function for an equivalent non-visual mode.
criteria.testingGuidance: Use keyboard operation, screen reader output, programmatic inspection, and representative workflow checks.
criteria.expectedResult: Each applicable function has an effective non-visual mode.
criteria.failures: An applicable workflow requires visual-only cues.
criteria.fixes: Provide equivalent non-visual information and operation.

criteria.title: With Limited Vision
criteria.desc: Where a visual mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that enables users to make use of limited vision.
criteria.requirement: Where a visual mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that enables users to make use of limited vision.
criteria.testingRequirements: Evaluate visual presentation, resizing, magnification, contrast, focus, and readability.
criteria.testingGuidance: Test with zoom, magnification, low-vision settings, and contrast checks.
criteria.expectedResult: Users with limited vision can perceive and operate applicable functions.
criteria.failures: Interfaces fail at applicable low-vision settings.
criteria.fixes: Preserve readability, layout integrity, and control operability.

criteria.title: Without Perception of Color
criteria.desc: Where a visual mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one visual mode of operation that does not require user perception of color.
criteria.requirement: Where a visual mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one visual mode of operation that does not require user perception of color.
criteria.testingRequirements: Evaluate status, state, error, and distinction cues that use color.
criteria.testingGuidance: Inspect workflows with color perception removed and confirm equivalent non-color cues.
criteria.expectedResult: Color is not required to understand or operate an applicable function.
criteria.failures: Status or instructions are conveyed by color alone.

criteria.title: Without Hearing
criteria.desc: Where an audible mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that does not require user hearing.
criteria.requirement: Where an audible mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that does not require user hearing.
criteria.testingRequirements: Evaluate audible alerts, speech, audio content, and audio-dependent instructions.
criteria.testingGuidance: Perform workflows with audio unavailable and verify equivalent visual, textual, or tactile information.
criteria.expectedResult: An effective non-auditory mode is available.
criteria.failures: Necessary information is communicated through sound only.
criteria.fixes: Provide equivalent visual, textual, or tactile output.

criteria.title: With Limited Hearing
criteria.desc: Where an audible mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that enables users to make use of limited hearing.
criteria.requirement: Where an audible mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that enables users to make use of limited hearing.
criteria.testingRequirements: Evaluate volume, clarity, frequency, captions, transcripts, and alternatives.
criteria.testingGuidance: Test with reduced hearing conditions and assistive listening considerations.
criteria.expectedResult: Users with limited hearing can perceive and operate applicable audible functions.
criteria.failures: An audible function cannot be understood with limited hearing.
criteria.fixes: Provide clear adjustable audio and equivalent captions or text.

criteria.title: Without Speech
criteria.desc: Where speech is used for input, control, or operation, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that does not require user speech.
criteria.requirement: Where speech is used for input, control, or operation, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that does not require user speech.
criteria.testingRequirements: Identify speech-dependent input or control and evaluate an equivalent non-speech interaction.
criteria.testingGuidance: Complete workflows without speech using keyboard, pointer, text, or other supported input.
criteria.expectedResult: Speech is not required for applicable operation.
criteria.failures: A required workflow depends on spoken input with no equivalent.
criteria.fixes: Provide equivalent keyboard, pointer, text, or other non-speech interaction.

criteria.title: With Limited Manipulation
criteria.desc: Where a manual mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that does not require fine motor control or simultaneous manual operations.
criteria.requirement: Where a manual mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that does not require fine motor control or simultaneous manual operations.
criteria.testingRequirements: Evaluate manual controls, gestures, timing, precision, and simultaneous actions.
criteria.testingGuidance: Test with keyboard access, alternate input, reduced precision, and single-action operation.
criteria.expectedResult: Applicable functions can be operated without fine motor control or simultaneous operations.
criteria.failures: Controls require precise movement or simultaneous action.
criteria.fixes: Provide keyboard operation and alternatives to precision gestures.

criteria.title: With Limited Reach and Strength
criteria.desc: Where a manual mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that is operable with limited reach and limited strength.
criteria.requirement: Where a manual mode of operation is provided, ICT shall provide at least one mode of operation that is operable with limited reach and limited strength.
criteria.testingRequirements: Evaluate reach distance, activation force, target placement, and physical or pointer operation.
criteria.testingGuidance: Test with alternate positioning and input methods.
criteria.expectedResult: Applicable functions are operable with limited reach and limited strength.
criteria.failures: A required control demands excessive reach, force, or sustained effort.
criteria.fixes: Provide alternate operation and appropriate target placement.

criteria.title: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
criteria.desc: ICT shall provide features making its use by individuals with limited cognitive, language, and learning abilities simpler and easier.
criteria.requirement: ICT shall provide features making its use by individuals with limited cognitive, language, and learning abilities simpler and easier.
criteria.testingRequirements: Evaluate language, instructions, consistency, error recovery, predictability, and cognitive load.
criteria.testingGuidance: Use representative tasks with clear instructions and observe understanding, learning, completion, and recovery.
criteria.expectedResult: Applicable workflows provide features that make use simpler and easier.
criteria.failures: Instructions, language, consistency, or recovery support make use unnecessarily difficult.
criteria.fixes: Use clear language, predictable structure, helpful instructions, and recovery support.
criteria.disabilitie: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities

criteria.title: Software and Assistive Technology Interoperability
criteria.desc: Software should expose information, relationships, states, and operations through platform accessibility services or other supported interoperability mechanisms.
criteria.requirement: Software should expose information, relationships, states, and operations through platform accessibility services or other supported interoperability mechanisms.
criteria.testingRequirements: Inspect software accessibility API exposure and test representative assistive technology workflows.
criteria.testingGuidance: Use platform accessibility inspectors and assistive technology to verify names, roles, states, values, and relationships.
criteria.expectedResult: Assistive technology can obtain and operate important user interface information.
criteria.failures: Assistive technology cannot obtain or operate important user interface information.
criteria.fixes: Use platform accessibility APIs and preserve programmatic names, roles, states, values, and relationships.

criteria.title: Support Documentation and Services
criteria.desc: Product documentation and support services should be available in accessible formats and through accessible communication channels.
criteria.requirement: Product documentation and support services should be available in accessible formats and through accessible communication channels.
criteria.testingRequirements: Review product documentation, alternate formats, contact methods, and support communication channels.
criteria.testingGuidance: Test documentation with assistive technology and use support channels through accessible communication methods.
criteria.expectedResult: Users can obtain accessible documentation and use support services.
criteria.failures: Users cannot obtain accessible documentation or use the support channel with assistive technology.
criteria.fixes: Provide accessible documentation, contact methods, and alternate formats.
